subject: Evidence completeness review and redline log for Acme marketplace listing
messages:
From: Jill Moreno <jill.moreno@acmehealth.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@cloudmarketplace.co>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Evidence checklist for Redwood listing – timeline & gaps

Marcus,

Thanks for the call this morning. To get Redwood listed in the GCP + AWS catalogs and to make the co-sell motion smooth, procurement needs a single package that proves compliance scope. Specifically we need: 

- SOC 2 Type II report covering hosting and change-management (most recent period)
- Pen test attestation or remediation summary for the public endpoints exposed to marketplace integrations
- A DPA that includes subprocessors and retention limits (we have a few redlines)

Can you confirm those three items and whether you can deliver a consolidated evidence matrix by next Friday (2027-04-10)? We also have a contract playbook call on Tuesday – will loop in procurement if anything requires legal escalation.

Background: Acme requires explicit subprocessor disclosure and a clause that limits retention to 90 days for transient logs related to marketplace billing. If Redwood can provide a DPA with suggested language, that will speed approval.

For reference, I attached the checklist we circulate internally.

Jill Moreno
Sr. Partner Programs Manager
Acme Health
jill.moreno@acmehealth.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: acme_required_fields_list.pdf

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Moreno <jill.moreno@acmehealth.com>, Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@cloudmarketplace.co>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence checklist for Redwood listing – timeline & gaps

Jill – thanks and appreciated. Short answer: yes, we can deliver. Below is a proposed workplan and what you should expect in the consolidated package.

Planned deliverables (by 2027-04-08):
- Evidence matrix (spreadsheet) mapping Acme checklist to artifacts + last-updated date (attachment: evidence_matrix_acme_20270403.xlsx)
- SOC 2 Type II PDF (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf) – covers production, change mgmt, and hosting ops
- Pen test attestation (Redwood_PenTest_Attestation_2026.pdf) with CVSS summary and remediation timeline
- DPA with our suggested language and a tracked redline for your team to review (DPA_redline_acme_20270402.docx)

Immediate items / owners:
- Laura (cc) to review the DPA redlines and provide minimal alternative language for subprocessor disclosure and retention clause (ETA 2027-04-05).
- Priyom (cc) to confirm the pen test scope mapping to marketplace endpoints and annotate the evidence matrix (ETA 2027-04-06).
- Vanessa (cc) to upload SOC 2 and pen test PDF to a secure shared drive and provide download links (ETA 2027-04-04).

If any of the above slips or you need a narrowed artifact set for procurement (e.g., only SOC2 and DPA first), tell me and we will prioritize. We can also open a DocuSign envelope for the DPA once Acme confirms the tracked version.

On timing: we aim to get the Docs to you by EOD Thu (4/8) to leave Acme legal/procurement time before Fri (4/10).

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Attachment: evidence_matrix_acme_20270403.xlsx; Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf; Redwood_PenTest_Attestation_2026.pdf

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Moreno <jill.moreno@acmehealth.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence checklist for Redwood listing – DPA redline notes

Hi Jill / Marcus,

I reviewed Acme’s note about subprocessor disclosure and retention limits. High-level proposed positions below (tracked in DPA_redline_acme_20270402.docx):

- Subprocessors: We will provide a current list of subprocessors and commit to 30 days notice for changes. We cannot agree to blanket prior-approval semantics for all subprocessors; we'll accept approval for a named subset of ‘‘sensitive subprocessors’’ (payment, KMS).
- Retention: We can commit to a 90-day retention limit for transient billing logs tied to marketplace transactions; however, security logs and forensic data must be retained longer for incident response. We propose a carve-out: 90 days for billing/tracking; 2 years for audit/security logs.
- Liability/indemnity: propose a mutual cap aligned to the existing commercial terms.

Next steps: Marcus will circulate the tracked DPA to Acme. If Acme legal requests further edits, we’ll handle redline rounds but prefer to land on an agreed text quickly so procurement can sign. I’ve flagged two clauses in the doc for legal attention — see comments.

Laura Bennett
Head, Trust & Security – Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Attachment: DPA_redline_acme_20270402.docx

From: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@cloudmarketplace.co>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jill Moreno <jill.moreno@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence checklist for Redwood listing – timeline & gaps

Marcus / Jill,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the matrix. Procurement has reviewed the SOC2 and pen test attestation and those look good. Two quick asks before we escalate to signature: 

1) Please provide a download link to the SOC2 PDF (we need to store it in our compliance vault).
2) We’ll need the DocuSign envelope for the DPA once Redwood confirms the final tracked version.

We’re aiming to complete internal approvals by Fri 4/9. If you can get the DocuSign link over today, procurement should be able to sign the same day.

DocuSign envelope requested (procurement@acmehealth.com is the signer).

Suresh Patel
Senior Marketplace Operations
CloudMarketplace Co.
suresh.patel@cloudmarketplace.co
Attachment: none
